Stockbee Weekly

Earnings — Most Anticipated This Week

Auto-discovered weekly @eWhispers chart — the dashboard scans Twitter's public syndication endpoint daily for the latest "Most Anticipated" tweet, extracts the image URL, and renders it below. No manual pasting, no Twitter JS. Companion grid is our own daily scrape of earningswhispers.com's API with clickable tickers into the drilldown panel.

Unusual Options Activity

Smart-money options flow — sweeps, blocks & golden sweeps across the liquid optionable market, ranked by Trade Score. Snapshot batch from Polygon Options Starter; refreshes 6× per RTH day (~75 min cadence). Not real-time tick data.

Quick filters:

Every flagged signal, scored as it ages — next-day OI status (did the position stick?) and realized forward return. Builds up over the days following each scan.

Delayed Feed — rolling notable options flow across ~180 liquid optionables (mega-caps PLUS the SMID / high-beta cohort where UOA edge lives, plus your watchlist). A fill surfaces if its premium clears Min premium OR its volume / open-interest ratio clears Min vol/OI — so a $80K bet on a $3B mcap that's 12× the existing OI shows up alongside NVDA's $5M sweeps. Each row is tagged 🥇 Golden 🔥 Big 📈 Unusual or · Active. Polled every 60 sec; new fills flash gold for 3 sec. Data delayed 15 minutes (Polygon Options Starter license). True per-print streaming would need a Polygon Advanced upgrade.

Frequently asked

What's a research report?
An on-demand 8-12 page PDF on any ticker, generated by Claude Opus using current market data, recent filings, news, and alt-data. Typically takes 2-3 minutes. Covers the bull/bear case, recent flow, key levels, catalyst calendar, and a clear takeaway. Pro gets 10/month, Premium gets 100/month.
Can I cancel mid-month?
Yes. Cancel any time from your account settings. Your access continues through the end of your current billing period. No partial refunds, but no questions asked either.
Do I need a credit card to try TickerDesk?
No. Free tier requires zero card info — sign in with email magic link or Google. You only enter a card if you choose to upgrade to Pro or Premium.
What's the difference between Pro and Premium?
Pro is built for one trader running their own watchlist. Premium adds bulk research (10× the reports), multi-watchlist support, advanced alert routing (push + webhook + Discord), and 1:1 onboarding. If you run multiple strategies or trade full-time, Premium is the right pick.
How do you handle my data?
Your watchlist, notes, and trade journal stay private (RLS-enforced — even our admin can't read across users without audit). We never sell user data. See our Privacy Policy for the full details.
What if I don't want a recurring subscription?
The Free tier is genuinely useful long-term. If you only occasionally want a deep-dive report, the 3 lifetime reports on Free should cover sporadic use. We don't currently offer one-time report purchases but it's on the roadmap.
Can I get a refund?
If you cancel within 7 days of your first payment and haven't generated more than 3 reports, email support@tickerdesk.io and we'll issue a full refund. After that, we don't offer refunds for partial months — but you can cancel any time to stop future billing.
